in_sanskrit.name: Chahak
in_sanskrit.meaning: Sky gazer, observer of the heavens
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who gazes intently at the sky or the heavens

in_hindi.name: चाहक
in_hindi.meaning: One who gazes at the sky intently, one who desires the heavens
in_hindi.long_meaning: One who intently looks at or desires the sky or the heavens

in_tamil.name: சாக்
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who observes the celestial bodies in the sky

in_telugu.name: చహక్
in_telugu.long_meaning: One who keeps watch over the sky

in_marathi.name: Chahak
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Echo, Sound, Vibration
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chahak हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Chahak is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Chahak’ which means an echo or a sound. This name is associated with the Vedic God of sound, Saraswati, and is believed to bring the blessings of creativity, knowledge, and wisdom.
